brief.summary: Five successive advisories and dozens of news reports agree that Cyclone Remal will reach the West Bengal–Bangladesh coast near the Sundarbans tonight, about 8 hours after this snapshot. The track has settled, with the latest shift under 10 km. Certainty is held just below the top band because no river forecast is available and the GDACS wind is a later reprocessed value.

reasons.text: Five advisories over 24 hours have converged on a northward track crossing about 21.8N 88.8E, and the latest track shift is only 9.3 km with a 1.4-hour ETA change, after an earlier maximum shift of 74.3 km.

River forecasts as issued were not archived, so this replay has no river forecast: only readings from days already over.
